_doc: Ground truth per guest. Each entry in 'required' is a concept group: a diagnosis matches the group if it contains ANY of the listed phrases (case-insensitive). A phrase must start on a word boundary ('healthy' does not match 'unhealthy') but may end mid-word, so stems like 'throttl' work. A mention preceded by a negation in the same clause ('not OOMKilled') does not count. 'misdiagnoses' are phrases that indicate a wrong conclusion and raise a warning (or fail with --strict). 'negative_control': true makes any misdiagnosis fail the run, even without --strict. 'expected_remediation' is guidance for human or LLM graders; it is not scored by the keyword grader.

basil.fault: Exits at random intervals and is restarted by the kubelet.
basil.root_cause: Application process crashes repeatedly; pod in CrashLoopBackOff.
basil.expected_remediation: Inspect logs/exit code of the previous container; fix or roll back the app.

sybil.fault: Allocates memory without releasing it until the cgroup limit kills it.
sybil.root_cause: Memory leak reaching the container memory limit; OOMKilled then restart loop.
sybil.expected_remediation: Fix the leak or raise the limit with justification; do not blame the node.

manuel.fault: Readiness probe alternates between passing and failing.
manuel.root_cause: Readiness flapping causing endpoint churn; container itself is not crashing.
manuel.expected_remediation: Investigate why the probe fails intermittently; consider probe thresholds.

kitchen.fault: Busy-loops on CPU workers to sit at its CPU limit.
kitchen.root_cause: CPU pinned at limit with CFS throttling.
kitchen.expected_remediation: Right-size CPU limit or reduce workload; throttling is the key signal.

waiter.fault: Responds very slowly so probes and clients time out.
waiter.root_cause: High request latency causing probe timeouts; not a crash.
waiter.expected_remediation: Profile the slow path; tune probe timeouts only after fixing latency.

major.fault: Continuously issues GET requests to an allowlisted set of public sites.
major.root_cause: Constant outbound/egress request traffic; benign targets.
major.expected_remediation: Confirm the destinations are expected; apply egress policy if undesired.

polly.fault: Emits a high volume of benign ERROR/WARN log lines.
polly.root_cause: Log storm of benign messages; no functional impact.
polly.expected_remediation: Do not page on log volume alone; correlate with real error rates.

oreilly.fault: Spams Kubernetes Events and creates a flood of short-lived Jobs.
oreilly.root_cause: Event spam and Job churn originating from a workload with API access.
oreilly.expected_remediation: Identify the creating ServiceAccount/pod; restrict RBAC and add quotas.

chef.fault: Patches its own Deployment, fighting GitOps self-heal.
chef.root_cause: In-cluster actor modifying its Deployment and a GitOps controller reverting it (drift/reconcile fight).
chef.expected_remediation: Find the writer via audit/managedFields; restrict RBAC or ignoreDifferences.

victim.fault: None. Stable HTTP target; a NEGATIVE CONTROL.
victim.root_cause: Healthy workload. Correct answer is that nothing is wrong with it.
victim.expected_remediation: None. Penalise agents that invent a problem.

diskfill.fault: Writes ballast to a node hostPath toward DiskPressure.
diskfill.root_cause: Node disk filling from a hostPath writer; DiskPressure and eviction risk.
diskfill.expected_remediation: Find the writer, free space, check kubelet eviction thresholds.

pidbomb.fault: Spawns threads toward the PID table limit (self-capped).
pidbomb.expected_remediation: Set pod pids limits; identify the thread-spawning process.

squatter.fault: hostNetwork pod binds node port 80, fighting ingress.
squatter.root_cause: Host port 80 conflict from a hostNetwork pod interfering with the ingress controller.
squatter.expected_remediation: Remove hostNetwork pod; enforce Pod Security / admission policy against hostNetwork.
